lines: In Sentry, the company policy is written down as three rules.
Rule D G one: personal data, sent to an untrusted external destination. Its suggested enforcement is block.
Rule D G two says the same for health data, and D G four for restricted data.
Untrusted means outside the organization. The cluster's own services count as inside. Here the contracted courier runs as one of them.
So does any address on a list the company sets.
The forecaster's address is on neither: external, and untrusted.
Sentry evaluates the rules with O P A, the Open Policy Agent. Here is rule D G one, in Rego, as O P A runs it in this cluster.
Any flow that carries an item tagged P I I, to a destination that is external and untrusted, fires the rule.
